rows.name: zeroSide_eventually_neg
rows.statement: theorem zeroSide_eventually_neg (H : PWSetup Zeta23.zetaZeroConfig g0 L M) (ρs : ℂ) (hρs : ρs ∈ tieSet Zeta23.zetaZeroConfig g0 M) : ∃ (a : List ℝ) (j : ℕ), (zeroSide (kWindow a g0 j)).re < 0
rows.what: the index j at which the zero side is negative: j = max J D (:1093, :1095)
rows.witness: J from `Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp (rest_tendsto_zero H Q B D hQb) _ hc0` (:1092) -- an existential out of a limit with no rate; D from coeffs_exist

rows.name: rest_tendsto_zero
rows.statement: theorem rest_tendsto_zero (H : PWSetup Zeta23.zetaZeroConfig g0 L M) (Q : ℕ → Polynomial ℝ) (B : ℝ) (D : ℕ) (hB : ∀ j (w : ℂ), ‖Polynomial.aeval w (Pof H (Q j))‖ ≤ B * (1 + ‖w‖) ^ D) : Tendsto (fun j => ∑' x, fR H Q j x / (M : ℂ) ^ (2 ^ (j + 1))) atTop (𝓝 0)
rows.what: the rest over M^(2^(j+1)) tends to 0: a Tendsto, no index
rows.witness: per zero `tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one` on offScore/M < 1 (:1055-:1057), no uniform ratio; summed by `tendsto_tsum_of_dominated_convergence` (:1066) -- no rate

rows.name: tie_term_neg
rows.statement: theorem tie_term_neg (H : PWSetup Z g0 L M) (Q : Polynomial ℝ) (j : ℕ) (hQ : ∀ ρ ∈ tieSet Z g0 M, (Polynomial.aeval (vOf ρ) Q) ^ 2 * Xval H j ρ = -(‖Xval H j ρ‖ : ℂ)) {ρ : ℂ} (hρ : ρ ∈ tieSet Z g0 M) : (Zeta23.paperFT (kWindow (coeffList (Pof H Q)) g0 j) (Zeta23.gammaOf ρ)).re = -(Nf H ρ * M ^ (2 ^ (j + 1)))
rows.what: the tie term`s real part, an equality at every j: -(N_rho M^(2^(j+1)))
rows.witness: N_rho = Nf H rho = |K(v)^2 (1 - c^2 v)| (:445), K over the kill nodes (:271), c = cE over the tie set (:274); M the dominant score

rows.name: kill_term_zero
rows.statement: theorem kill_term_zero (H : PWSetup Z g0 L M) (Q : Polynomial ℝ) (j : ℕ) {ρ : ℂ} (hρ : ρ ∈ killSet Z g0 M) : Zeta23.paperFT (kWindow (coeffList (Pof H Q)) g0 j) (Zeta23.gammaOf ρ) = 0
rows.what: the kill term is 0 at every j

rows.name: rest_term_small
rows.statement: theorem rest_term_small (H : PWSetup Z g0 L M) (Q : Polynomial ℝ) (B : ℝ) (D : ℕ) (hB : ∀ w : ℂ, ‖Polynomial.aeval w (Pof H Q)‖ ≤ B * (1 + ‖w‖) ^ D) (j : ℕ) (ρ : ℂ) : ‖Zeta23.paperFT (kWindow (coeffList (Pof H Q)) g0 j) (Zeta23.gammaOf ρ)‖ ≤ B ^ 2 * (1 + ‖wOf ρ‖) ^ (2 * D) * offScore g0 ρ ^ (2 ^ (j + 1))
rows.what: each term bounded at every j: B^2 (1 + |w|)^(2D) offScore^(2^(j+1))
rows.witness: the bound is a closed term in B, D (from coeffs_exist) and the zero`s own offScore and |w| = |gammaOf rho|

rows.name: coeffs_exist
rows.statement: theorem coeffs_exist (H : PWSetup Z g0 L M) (hne : (tieSet Z g0 M).Nonempty) : ∃ B : ℝ, ∃ D : ℕ, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ j : ℕ, ∃ Q : Polynomial ℝ, (∀ ρ ∈ tieSet Z g0 M, (Polynomial.aeval (vOf ρ) Q) ^ 2 * Xval H j ρ = -(‖Xval H j ρ‖ : ℂ)) ∧ ∀ w : ℂ, ‖Polynomial.aeval w (Pof H Q)‖ ≤ B * (1 + ‖w‖) ^ D
rows.what: there are B, D bounding every P_j
rows.witness: B = card(VF) * max CV 0 * BK * BE, D = 2 card(VF) + 2 DK + DE (:683); CV from real_even_interpolant over the tie nodes, BK, DK and BE, DE from fixed_poly_bound (:667) of Kp and Ep

rows.name: dominant_summable
rows.statement: theorem dominant_summable (H : PWSetup Zeta23.zetaZeroConfig g0 L M) (B : ℝ) (D : ℕ) : Summable (fun ρ : Zeta23.zetaZeroConfig.carrier => (Zeta23.zetaZeroConfig.mult ρ : ℝ) * (B ^ 2 * (1 + ‖wOf ρ‖) ^ (2 * D) * (offScore g0 ρ / M) ^ (2 ^ (D + 1))))
rows.what: the dominant is summable; its sum bounded by 3 A0 Bf zeta3Sum (weighted_finite_bound :879)
rows.witness: Bf = 128 * 8^D * B^2 * (Aw H / M)^(2^(D+1)) (:957); A0 from zetaZeroConfig_local_count (:952)

rows.name: Aw
rows.statement: def Aw (_H : PWSetup Z g0 L M) : ℝ
rows.what: the decay constant of the base: (INT |g0| + INT |g0````|) e^(L/2)
rows.witness: a closed term in the base window

rows.name: paperFT_decay
rows.statement: theorem paperFT_decay (p : ℕ) {g : ℝ → ℝ} {L : ℝ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ p g) (hs : Function.support g ⊆ Set.Icc (-L) L) (z : ℂ) : ‖Zeta23.paperFT (phiC g) z‖ * ‖z‖ ^ p ≤ (∫ u, |iteratedDeriv p g u|) * Real.exp (L * |z.im|)
rows.witness: a closed term in the window and z

rows.name: paperFT_decay_zero
rows.statement: theorem paperFT_decay_zero {g : ℝ → ℝ} {L : ℝ} (hg : Continuous g) (hs : Function.support g ⊆ Set.Icc (-L) L) (z : ℂ) : ‖Zeta23.paperFT (phiC g) z‖ ≤ (∫ u, |g u|) * Real.exp (L * |z.im|)
rows.witness: a closed term in the window and z

rows.name: zetaZeroConfig_local_count
rows.statement: theorem zetaZeroConfig_local_count : ∃ A₀ : ℝ, 1 ≤ A₀ ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, (zetaZeroConfig.N t (t + 1) : ℝ) ≤ A₀ * Real.log (|t| + 3)
rows.what: N(t, t+1) <= A0 log(|t| + 3) with 1 <= A0
rows.witness: A0 = max 1 (max (2 A1) K) (:287), K = Ncount (-4) 5 (:285), A1 = (1 / log(R/r)) (|log(3C)| + 2 max A 0) (:122) with r = 0.84, R = 0.95 and A, C from zeta_growth_right (ZetaGrowth.lean:159)

rows.name: base_nonzero_at
rows.statement: theorem base_nonzero_at (F : ℝ) (hF0 : 0 < F) (hF1 : F < 1) (z : ℂ) : ∃ L₀ : ℝ, 0 < L₀ ∧ ∀ (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L), L ≤ L₀ → Zeta23.paperFT (phiC (plateau F L hF0 hF1 hL)) z ≠ 0
rows.what: a width below which the plateau`s transform is nonzero at z
rows.witness: L0 = 1 / (4 (|z| + 1)) (:276); at the assembly z = gammaOf rho1, so the base half-support is 1 / (4 (|gammaOf rho1| + 1))

rows.name: plateau_dominant
rows.statement: theorem plateau_dominant (Z : Zeta23.ZeroConfig) (F : ℝ) (hF0 : 0 < F) (hF1 : F < 1) (ρ₁ : ℂ) (h₁ : ρ₁ ∈ Z.carrier) (hoff : ρ₁.re ≠ 1 / 2) : ∃ (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L), ∃ ρs ∈ Z.carrier, ρs.re ≠ 1 / 2 ∧ 0 < offScore (plateau F L hF0 hF1 hL) ρs ∧ ∀ ρ ∈ Z.carrier, ρ.re ≠ 1 / 2 → offScore (plateau F L hF0 hF1 hL) ρ ≤ offScore (plateau F L hF0 hF1 hL) ρs
rows.what: the base width and a dominant off-line zero rho_s of the largest score M
rows.witness: the width from base_nonzero_at at rho1 (:389); rho_s from dominant_exists (:394)

rows.name: dominant_exists
rows.statement: theorem dominant_exists (Z : Zeta23.ZeroConfig) {g : ℝ → ℝ} {L : ℝ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ 4 g) (hs : Function.support g ⊆ Set.Icc (-L) L) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (ρ₁ : ℂ) (h₁ : ρ₁ ∈ Z.carrier) (hoff : ρ₁.re ≠ 1 / 2) (hpos : 0 < offScore g ρ₁) : ∃ ρs ∈ Z.carrier, ρs.re ≠ 1 / 2 ∧ 0 < offScore g ρs ∧ ∀ ρ ∈ Z.carrier, ρ.re ≠ 1 / 2 → offScore g ρ ≤ offScore g ρs
rows.what: an off-line zero of maximal score
rows.witness: a maximiser by `Set.exists_max_image` over the finite set of off-line zeros scoring at least offScore(rho1) (:377): a zero of zeta, not a term in rho1

rows.name: off_finite_above
rows.statement: theorem off_finite_above (Z : Zeta23.ZeroConfig) {g : ℝ → ℝ} {L : ℝ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ 4 g) (hs : Function.support g ⊆ Set.Icc (-L) L) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) : {ρ | ρ ∈ Z.carrier ∧ c ≤ offScore g ρ}.Finite
rows.what: zeros of score at least c lie below height T

rows.name: real_even_interpolant
rows.statement: theorem real_even_interpolant (s : Finset ℂ) (hconj : ∀ w ∈ s, conj w ∈ s) : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ r : ℂ → ℂ, (∀ w ∈ s, r (conj w) = conj (r w)) → (∀ w ∈ s, ‖r w‖ ≤ 1) → ∃ Q : Polynomial ℝ, (∀ w ∈ s, (Q.map (algebraMap ℝ ℂ)).eval w = r w) ∧ Q.degree < s.card ∧ ∀ j, |Q.coeff j| ≤ C
rows.what: a coefficient bound for real interpolants on a node set
rows.witness: CV = SUM_j SUM_i |(Lagrange.basis s id i).coeff j| (:432): a closed term in the nodes, the nodes being the tie set`s v
